DPS is calculated as Overcharge ÷ (Charge-Up + Cooldown + [Overcharge ÷ Damage x Tick]).
Maximum DPS is calculated as [Highest Damage × (Burst Time ÷ Tick)] ÷ (Charge-Up + Burst Time + Cooldown). Actual DPS may vary from time to time.
Average DPS is calculated as [(Highest Damage + Lowest Damage) ÷ 2 × (Burst Time ÷ Tick)] ÷ (Charge-Up + Burst Time + Cooldown). Actual DPS may vary from time to time.
Minimum DPS is calculated as [Lowest Damage × (Burst Time ÷ Tick)] ÷ (Charge-Up + Burst Time + Cooldown). Actual DPS may vary from time to time.
